messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's hairstyle to the one shown in the reference images. Match the shape and styling of the hair in the reference images (front and back views), while retaining the current person's facial features, hair color, and clothing. Leave the rest of the video unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Please use the video where the person has black hair as the starting point and make the following change: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the person's hairstyle to the one shown in the reference images. Match the shape and styling of the hair in the reference images, while retaining the current person's facial features, hair color, and clothing. Leave the rest of the video unchanged.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The woman dances in the center of the frame, moving her arms and torso while turning and stepping across the floor.","camera":"The camera maintains a medium full shot at eye level, remaining mostly static with slight adjustments to follow her movement.","clothing":"She wears a sleeveless, patterned crop top with a keyhole neckline and a matching choker, paired with light gray, textured wide-leg pants and brown heeled boots.","hair_color":"Light gray or silver.","hairstyle":"Her hair is tied up in a high, voluminous ponytail with loose strands framing her face.","identity":"A slender young woman with fair skin and a slim build.","scene":"The setting is an indoor parking garage with concrete pillars marked 'A3', yellow and black striped barriers, red pipes on the ceiling, and a glossy reflective floor."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The woman's hair was changed from a loose high ponytail to a more elaborate updo with two side loops/buns and bangs, broadly matching the reference shape. Her hair color, clothing, dance motion, parking-garage scene, and camera framing remain largely the same.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's hairstyle to the reference style with twin looped buns/pigtails and bangs, while retaining facial features, hair color, clothing, and the rest of the video.
uncertain: Whether the hairstyle fully matches the reference from the back view during turns.
unexpected_changes: Hair appears somewhat messier and less defined than the reference, especially in later frames.
